criteria.evidence: Budgets one full run, shared preparation, and one focused checker evaluation per row. Keeps the global timeout.
criteria.reason: Adding a distinct rejection case normally costs one focused check.

criteria.evidence: Gives each row a private copy, reruns affected steps for earlier edits, and computes a fresh verdict with the production checker.
criteria.reason: Each rejection depends on the specific altered input while upstream preparation can be shared.

criteria.evidence: Asserts acceptance of a raw known-good input through the normal verifier and complete pipeline. Also checks that an untouched copy passes and every existing tamper row rejects.
criteria.reason: This exercises the preparation-to-verdict handoff and checks both outcomes at the shared fixture boundary.

criteria.evidence: Keeps the timeout and budgets the expanded group against its pre-change median. Runs every row through both pipelines during migration.
criteria.reason: The full comparison is temporary. The ongoing runner shares independent stages and reserves full runs for cases that need them.

criteria.evidence: Freezes trusted reference data per setup, recomputes the actual digest from each submitted artifact in its example, and calls the real checker with fresh state for every mutation.
criteria.reason: The trusted expectation can be reused while changed inputs and their dependent stages produce an independent decision.

criteria.evidence: Runs an untouched positive control through the ordinary end-to-end path. Requires each named existing and proposed mutation to change its target and receive a rejection.
criteria.reason: The complete path must accept a valid input, and the negative assertions each exercise an actual change.

criteria.evidence: Keeps one full CI run and the current global timeout. Adds focused rows for distinct new rejection obligations and defers duplicates.
criteria.reason: The expanded suite pays only for the additional checker work needed by each distinct case.

criteria.evidence: Copies the last unaffected intermediate for each row, restarts before any earlier mutation, and recomputes derived evidence and the final verdict with the production checker.
criteria.reason: Only work upstream of the change is shared, so each altered input can independently expose an erroneous acceptance.

criteria.evidence: Runs real preparation and the complete oracle on a known-good raw input, checks an untouched copy at the checker, and requires the documented rejection for each existing variant.
criteria.reason: The full-path acceptance and both fixture-level outcomes are asserted. A crash or timeout would fail the negative test.
